title: Caractérisation descriptive des performances v0.2.12

target.source_change_policy: Any source, harness or fixture change invalidates run design and requires new hashes/approval.

scope.scientific_boundary: Measure bounded representative workloads; characterize this environment only. No extrapolation or universal performance qualification.
required_contracts: wp02 through wp10 contracts applicable to selected paths
historical performance reports for comparison only

tracked_source_files: Selected source modules from the approved workload, listed before freeze
source_and_test_identity.sha256_inventory_file: Future harness input and fixture inventory; not available in WP12-0.
source_and_test_identity.inventory_completeness: Must remain incomplete until Owner approves a separate harness design; scripts/run_wp12_scaling.py is v0.2.7 and excluded.

planned_workloads: one small/medium prepared dynamic model at declared Nfull and Nr
reduced harmonic with declared mode/frequency counts
Newmark with declared step count and history policy
one nonlinear element/tangent and checkpoint case only if included
fixtures.identity_policy: Freeze deterministic generated model inputs and SHA-256 before execution; no workload can be selected dynamically after approval.

tests.parameterized_node_resolution: Not applicable; performance harness scenarios require their own immutable scenario IDs.

metrics: wall and CPU time per assembly/projection/factorization/solve/postprocess stage
number of factorizations and right-hand-side solves
Nfull, Nr, frequency count, time steps, retained history
process RSS including native allocations when available
success_conditions: All measurements include source/environment/workload identity and raw repeat values.
Report descriptive metrics only unless a separate Owner-approved performance limit already exists.
fail_or_stop_conditions: Stop at Owner-approved wall/RAM/disk limits; hardware/environment mismatch or missing instrumentation makes measurement inconclusive, not PASS.

environment.optional_solvers: List exact backend only if selected; no MPI/PETSc workload by default.

resource_limits.limit_enforcement: No benchmark before explicit numerical and storage limits; monitored metrics are not hard caps.

attempt_policy.retry_requires: Separate approval; preserve raw timings and failed/aborted observations.

evidence.partial_run_policy: Keep partial measurements and stop reason; no overwrite/retry.

notes: No runnable v0.2.12 performance harness is present. Historical synthetic/small measurements are not current candidate measurements.
